summary: Iteration 13 — validation of (1) NER spaCy local, (2) UNCLOS qualification of PoE-less EEZs, (3) OSM confidence / spatial-anomaly badges on the map, (4) non-destructivity. NEW test file /app/backend/tests/test_ner_unclos_osm.py: 16/16 pytest PASS. Backend verified: GET /api/ml/status exposes models.ner_model (ents_f=0.9682, p=r=0.9682, n_train=5041, labels exactly [LOCATION, PORT_NAME, PROJECT_NAME]); POST /api/ml/ner/extract on 'Port de Papeete, Tahiti (French Polynesia). Clearance douanière au quai.' returns a PORT_NAME entity containing 'Papeete' (empty text -> 400, correct); GET /api/ml/train/ner/status returns running=false/error=null; POST /api/poe/qualify-unclos -> zones_scanned=285, qualified=120, by_code populated for sovereign_entry/uninhabited/overlapping_claim/joint_regime; GET /api/poe/zones -> 285 items, EVERY zone with poe_count=0 has unclos{code,basis} (120 in Mongo) and NO zone with poe_count>0 exposes unclos (no leak, no _id); GET /api/poe/ports -> 1171 features carrying osm_confidence/osm_tags/spatial_anomaly, >300 (513 at test time, then 527) with non-null osm_confidence and 50 spatial_anomaly=true; GET /api/poe/validate-osm/status shows running=true with progress strictly increasing over 8 s and osm_checked_total growing. Unit checks on poe.py: qualify_unclos overlapping_claim / joint_regime / antarctic (lat<-60) / uninhabited (Clipperton) / sovereign_entry, None when poe_count=5; localized_query({'sov_iso2':'FR'}) returns the French template, 16 QUERY_TEMPLATES, None for an unknown ISO2. Frontend (Playwright, real external URL): Formalities mode loads 1171 PoE markers; Port Chilkoot popup shows the green badge 'OSM confidence 0.55' (computed colour rgb(57,255,20)); Letnikof Cove Dock (confidence 0) shows the grey '∅ No OSM infrastructure within 3 km' variant; Dutch Harbor Small Boat Harbor shows 'OSM confidence 0.60' + red '⚠ Spatial anomaly (ML)' (rgb(255,74,74)); Aruba (poe_count=0) zone popup shows the blue '§ LEGAL STATUS (UNCLOS) · UNCLOS ART. 17-19' block with the innocent-passage explanation; Albania (4 PoE) popup contains NO UNCLOS block; Projects mode still lists 4463 projects. Zero console/page errors in every run. Mongo counts identical before/after: projects 4463, poe_ports 1171, eez_zones 285.

minor.issue: No 'state' field (shape is {running, started_at, finished_at, progress, total, error, summary, cancelling}) and NER_STATE is an in-process global: after the backend reloaded, status returned running=false/summary=null even though a trained model exists on disk. Clients cannot tell 'never trained' from 'trained earlier'. Suggest persisting the last summary (from models/ner_meta) into the status payload.

uvicorn runs with --reload watching /app/backend, so ANY file touched there (including /app/backend/tests/*.py) restarts the process and silently kills the Overpass validation task with no persisted state. It died twice during this session (at osm_checked 371 and 513) and had to be resumed with POST /api/poe/validate-osm {only_unchecked:true}. Consider persisting job state in Mongo and/or auto-resume on startup, or keep test files outside the reload dir.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicated label: renders 'OSM OSM confidence 0.55' because the template prepends 'OSM ' while i18n poeOsmConfidence is already 'OSM confidence' (FR: 'OSM Confiance OSM'). Cosmetic but visible in every popup.

issues: Still open from iterations 11/12: bottom attribution 'EEZ: Marine Regions (VLIZ) v12 — CC-BY 4.0 — Geocoding © OpenStreetMap / Nominatim' is ~8px dark grey on dark navy, contrast below WCAG AA (same for the in-popup attribution line).

action_items: LOW: remove the redundant 'OSM ' prefix in MapView.js osmBadge (label currently 'OSM OSM confidence 0.55')
LOW: make /api/ml/train/ner/status report the persisted model summary/state so it survives a process reload

MEDIUM (infra): persist / auto-resume the Overpass validate-osm job — it is killed by any backend hot reload. It was resumed and is RUNNING at report time (progress 14/658, osm_checked_total 527, high_confidence 324)
LOW: contrast of sidebar/popup attribution footers
critical_code_review_comments: poe.qualify_unclos is pure and ordered correctly (antarctic > overlapping > joint > uninhabited > sovereign_entry) and returns None as soon as poe_count>0, so zones with ports can never receive a legal-status label — verified both in unit tests and via /api/poe/zones (0 leaks over 285 zones).
poe_routes /poe/qualify-unclos is idempotent and additive: re-running it kept poe_ports=1171 / eez_zones=285 and only refreshed unclos.qualified_at.

MapView popups are built as raw HTML strings; all dynamic values go through escH() (including osm_tags in the title attribute) — no XSS hole spotted, but the badges have no data-testid, so popup assertions must rely on text matching (fragile: the UNCLOS title is uppercased by CSS text-transform, which broke a case-sensitive assertion). Recommend data-testid="poe-osm-badge" / "poe-anomaly-badge" / "zone-unclos-block".

Heavy map interactions crash the Chromium driver twice (setView to low zoom with 302 EEZ polygons + 1171 markers, and cluster.zoomToShowLayer) — likely memory/CPU pressure on the preview pod; end users on low-end machines could see the same jank. Worth profiling the EEZ layer (simplify geometry at low zoom).
ml_routes /ner/extract correctly 400s on empty text and 404s when no model is present; extraction runs in asyncio.to_thread so the event loop is not blocked.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 5 targeted flows (OSM badge, no-match badge, anomaly badge, UNCLOS block present/absent, Projects 4463) — 0 console errors

seed_data_creation: None. No data created or deleted. Additive side effects only: unclos{} on the 120 PoE-less zones (already present), osm_* fields growing as the Overpass job runs (345 -> 527 checked during the session).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fast regression: `cd /app/backend && python3 -m pytest tests/test_ner_unclos_osm.py -p no:randomly` (~33 s, 16 tests, non-destructive; the validate-osm status test self-skips if no job is running). WARNING: creating/editing any file under /app/backend triggers uvicorn --reload and KILLS the background Overpass job (state is in-process only) — resume with POST /api/poe/validate-osm {"only_unchecked":true}. Job was RUNNING when this report was written. Frontend gotchas: use the sidebar search + row click (data-testid mode-toggle-formalities, then fill the 'Search a country or EEZ' input and click the row) to open a zone popup; direct eez.eachLayer/setView at low zoom or cluster.zoomToShowLayer crashes the Playwright driver ('Connection closed'). For PoE badges use map.setView([lat,lon],15) then click .bi-status-icon markers: Port Chilkoot 59.2286/-135.4385 (conf 0.55), Letnikof Cove Dock (conf 0), Dutch Harbor Small Boat Harbor 53.8831/-166.5525 (conf 0.60 + spatial_anomaly). UNCLOS block titles are uppercased by CSS — use case-insensitive assertions. Known pre-existing failures elsewhere: test_refactor_core.py has 2 dedup_core.text_similarity failures (unfixed, see iteration_12).
rca_of_the_issue: Only test-side/cosmetic findings. (1) 'OSM OSM confidence' = the badge template hardcodes an 'OSM ' prefix in addition to the i18n string that already contains 'OSM confidence'. (2) /api/ml/train/ner/status losing its summary and the Overpass job dying both share one root cause: job state lives in module-level globals (NER_STATE, OSM validation state) inside a uvicorn --reload process whose watcher covers /app/backend, so any file write restarts the worker and wipes both the state and the running asyncio task; the model itself is on disk, hence /api/ml/status stays correct.
